rationale: C21 is a direct and material drafting template. It is an earlier Haiti sanctions order that the child expressly extends through its anti-evasion provision, and the child adapts C21's targeted blocking machinery from Haitian nationals supporting or doing substantial business with the de facto regime to persons obstructing specified democratization efforts, perpetrating violence, or supporting those actors. The two orders also share a distinctive sequence and extensive language: licensing and prior-obligation qualifications; property within the United States or controlled by U.S. persons; anti-evasion prohibition; Treasury implementation in consultation with State; redelegation and agency enforcement, including license suspension; no-private-right disclaimer; and effective-date, transmission, and publication clauses. C11 and C03 are strong secondary templates because they contain closely parallel Clinton-era sanctions language and structure, but neither has C21's same-country, directly continued sanctions program and targeted-person blocking mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all property and interests in property of persons ... Who have materially or financially supported any of the foregoing, that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States persons, including their overseas branches, are blocked
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all property and interests in property of any Haitian national providing substantial financial or material contributions to the de facto regime in Haiti, or doing substantial business with the de facto regime in Haiti ... that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States persons, including their overseas branches, are blocked
shared_material.explanation: The child materially adapts C21's targeted blocking provision, retaining its jurisdictional formula and support-based designation machinery while changing the designated conduct.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any transaction subject to U.S. jurisdiction that evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts to violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order, or in Executive Orders Nos. 12775, 12779, or 12853, is prohibited
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any transaction by any United States person that evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts to violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses C21's distinctive anti-evasion formula and expressly extends it to the earlier Haiti orders, including the order represented by C21.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations ... The Secretary of the Treasury may redelegate any of these functions ... all agencies of which are hereby directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority ... including suspension or termination of licenses or other authorizations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations ... The Secretary of the Treasury may redelegate any of these functions ... all agencies of which are hereby directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority ... including suspension or termination of licenses or other authorizations
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim reuse of the same implementation, redelegation, and interagency enforcement machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing contained in this order shall create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable by any party against the United States, its agencies or instrumentalities, its officers or employees, or any other person.

shared_material.explanation: The disclaimer is verbatim, reinforcing the broader evidence of direct drafting continuity.
